title: Chief of Staff product brief (platform + knowledge system)
body:
Problem: Fragmented org context; journal is turn history not structured knowledge; no 7th CoS role.

Mission: Capture, organize, understand, preserve, retrieve important org context for CEO + all AI employees.

Role id ASSUMPTION: chief-of-staff. Six v1 responsibilities: Conversation Recorder, Meeting Secretary, Knowledge Manager, Decision Tracker, EA follow-ups, Intelligence Analyst.

Two-layer hard rule: raw evidence (immutable) + curated knowledge (always source_ref); never replace originals with summaries.

Categories: CEO Profile; Company Profile; Projects; Technical Knowledge; Decisions; Tasks & Commitments; People & Stakeholders; Lessons Learned; Ideas & Opportunities; Historical Events.

Metadata: source_ref, recorded_at, project, category, verification_status, lifecycle (current|outdated|superseded). Verifiers: CEO + PM.

Consumers: all AI employees by default. Auto-ingest: chats, meetings, docs, email.

Delivery slices S1–S10 (MVP: S1→S6): S1 role scaffolding; S2 KB schemas under company-workspace/knowledge/; S3 chat journal→raw; S4 curated CRUD+source_ref; S5 verification queue; S6 context_pack; S7 docs; S8 tasks; S9 intelligence digest; S10 meeting/email connectors (NEEDS CEO).

Interim: thin CoS already on PM; remove after CoS ships.

Full brief path: company-workspace/chief-of-staff/product-brief.md

Open CEO decisions: meeting source; email provider/scope; KB location confirm; Decisions verify CEO-only vs PM; digest cadence; S10 stub OK.
